jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer (.NET/React)
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer (.NET/React) based in Spain.

As a Senior Full Stack Engineer, you will build and evolve scalable, secure, and high-performing applications across both backend and frontend layers. You will work extensively with .NET and C# alongside React, Redux, and JavaScript to deliver impactful software solutions. The role combines hands-on engineering with opportunities to influence architecture, technical decisions, and development practices. You will contribute to cloud-based solutions using Google Cloud Platform and modern CI/CD practices. Working closely with product managers, designers, and other stakeholders, you will translate business needs into robust technical solutions. You will also support code quality and team development through mentoring, collaboration, and knowledge sharing.

Accountabilities

Design, develop, test, and maintain scalable, secure, reliable, and efficient full-stack applications.
Build and maintain backend services using .NET, C#, PostgreSQL, and SQL Server.
Develop responsive and maintainable frontend components using React, Redux, and JavaScript.
Collaborate with product managers, designers, engineers, and other stakeholders to define and deliver new features.
Ensure applications meet high standards for performance, reliability, security, and maintainability.
Write clean, efficient, well-documented code while following established engineering best practices.
Participate in code reviews, provide constructive technical feedback, and promote high standards of code quality.
Troubleshoot, debug, and optimize applications to identify and resolve performance or reliability issues.
Contribute to software architecture discussions, technical design decisions, and long-term engineering strategy.
Design, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines to support continuous integration and deployment.
Apply cloud technologies and DevOps practices to improve development and delivery workflows.
Mentor junior engineers, share technical knowledge, and contribute to a collaborative engineering culture.
Keep up to date with emerging technologies and industry trends and identify opportunities for technical improvement.

Requirements

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Engineering, or a related field.
At least 4 years of professional software development experience, with strong expertise in .NET and C#.
Solid hands-on experience with PostgreSQL and SQL Server.
Strong frontend development skills with React, Redux, and JavaScript.
Practical experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and cloud-based application development.
Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines and modern DevOps practices.
Strong understanding of software architecture, design patterns, data structures, and scalable application design.
Experience using GitHub for version control, collaboration, and software development workflows.
Familiarity with Docker and Kubernetes is an advantage.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to troubleshoot complex technical challenges.
Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, collaborative, and continuously evolving environment.
Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
A proactive mindset with a willingness to mentor colleagues and contribute to continuous technical improvement.

Benefits

Fully remote working model, with the opportunity to work from Latam, Europe.
Flexible working conditions designed to support a healthy work-life balance.
Opportunity to work on challenging and impactful technology projects.
Exposure to modern cloud technologies, full-stack development, CI/CD, and DevOps practices.
Continuous learning and professional development opportunities.
Hands-on experience with technologies including .NET, React, GCP, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, and modern engineering tooling.
Collaboration with an international, diverse, and cross-cultural team of technology professionals.
Opportunities to contribute to architectural decisions and influence technical direction.
Full-time employment with the flexibility and autonomy of a remote-first environment.
Competitive compensation and benefits package, subject to the employment arrangement and location.

How Jobgether Works

We use an AI-powered matching process
to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

Why Apply Through Jobgether?

Data Privacy Notice:
By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Integration Developer Azure Platform
jobs.description:
As a customer-focused global logistics operator, Noatum Logistics
provides integrated, value-added supply chain solutions to customers worldwide. With an extensive network of offices across 26 countries, Noatum Logistics
relies on local experts to design and deliver tailored logistics solutions that meet each client's specific needs.

Recognized for its outstanding service and highly qualified professionals, the company has established itself as a leader in the logistics sector, offering solutions that support customers across a wide range of industries.

Our services include air, ocean, road, and rail freight transportation, customs brokerage, warehousing and distribution, and value-added supply chain services. Our solutions cover integrated supply chain management, 3PL logistics for e-commerce companies (eSolutions), cold chain and refrigerated logistics, and project cargo transportation.

Noatum Logistics
serves diverse industry sectors with deep expertise and specialized knowledge, including Fashion & Retail, Industrial & Construction, High-Tech & Consumer Electronics, Automotive, Food & Consumer Goods, Mining, Energy & Oil & Gas, Defense & Aerospace, and Pharmaceuticals & Healthcare.

At Noatum Logistics,
we encourage you to join our exciting growth journey.

We are currently looking for an Integration Developer – Azure Platform
to join our offices in Barcelona.

As an Integration Developer, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and supporting integrations that enable seamless and secure data exchange between internal and external systems.

Key Responsibilities:

• Design and develop integration solutions leveraging Azure-native services.
• Build and maintain integrations using Azure Logic Apps.
• Develop custom business logic and reusable components using Azure Functions (C#).
• Create, consume, and maintain RESTful APIs and event-driven integrations.
• Apply clean code principles and software engineering best practices.
• Manage source code through Git repositories and contribute to Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines.
• Perform testing, debugging, performance tuning, and troubleshooting activities.
• Collaborate with business stakeholders and technical teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
• Ensure compliance with security standards, authentication mechanisms, and governance policies.
• Monitor and support production integrations.
• Produce and maintain technical documentation and operational procedures.
• Contribute to the continuous improvement of the integration platform, aligned with Digital Cluster standards and architecture.

What We Offer:

• Permanent employment contract.
• Flexible working hours.
• Access to a flexible benefits package (private health insurance, transportation, etc.).
• Meal vouchers.
• An afternoon off on your birthday.
• Ongoing training through our Corporate University (Learning Platform).
• The opportunity to be part of a dynamic team with global impact.

At Noatum Logistics, we are committed to equal opportunities and non-discrimination regardless of gender, race, religion, disability, age, or sexual orientation throughout all recruitment processes. We are dedicated to maximizing diverse talent and preventing any form of discrimination.

Minimum requirements

• Degree in Computer Engineering, Software Development, Information Technology, or a related field.
• Minimum of 5 years of experience in integration development.
• Proven hands-on experience with:
o Azure Logic Apps
o Azure Functions
o C#
o REST APIs
o Azure Service Bus and/or Event Grid
• Solid knowledge of JSON and XML.
• Experience with Git and Azure DevOps (repositories and CI/CD pipelines).
• Strong understanding of Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) and event-driven architectures.
• Experience in incident resolution, testing, and integration support.
• Advanced level of English.
Nice to Have:

• Experience with Azure API Management (APIM).
• Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code (ARM, Bicep, or Terraform).
• Experience with OAuth 2.0, Managed Identity, and Application Insights.
• Microsoft Azure certifications.

jobs.title: Head of software Engineering
jobs.description:
Ultimate Peaks is seeking a strategic and dynamic Head of Software Engineering to lead our software development teams and drive the successful delivery of innovative technology solutions. The Head of Software Engineering will oversee the full software development lifecycle, foster a culture of technical excellence, and ensure alignment with business objectives.

In this leadership role, you will collaborate closely with product management, design, and operations teams to deliver scalable, high-quality software products that meet the evolving needs of our clients.

Key Responsibilities

Lead, mentor, and grow a talented team of software engineers across multiple projects
Define and implement software engineering best practices, development methodologies, and quality standards
Drive architectural decisions and ensure the scalability, reliability, and security of software solutions
Collaborate with product owners and stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical solutions
Manage project timelines, resource allocation, and delivery milestones to ensure on-time project completion
Promote a culture of continuous improvement, innovation, and knowledge sharing within the engineering team
Stay current with emerging technologies and industry trends to maintain competitive advantage

Qualifications & Experience

Proven experience (typically 10+ years) in software engineering with at least 3-5 years in a leadership role
Strong expertise in modern software development technologies, programming languages, and frameworks
Experience leading Agile teams and implementing Agile/Scrum processes
Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to make data-driven decisions
Strong communication and interpersonal skills to effectively collaborate across teams and with stakeholders
Experience managing multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment

Requirements

10+ years of professional software development experience
3-5 years in software engineering leadership roles such as Team Lead, Engineering Manager, or Head of Engineering
Proficiency in programming languages such as Java, Python, C#, or JavaScript
Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and DevOps practices
Demonstrated ability to lead and mentor engineering teams
Strong knowledge of software development lifecycle, Agile methodologies, and quality assurance
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills

jobs.company: Coordination régionale intervention par les pairs Nouvelle-Aquitaine
jobs.title: Engineering Manage
jobs.description:
Role Description
The Engineering Manager will provide technical leadership and team coordination for remote engineering initiatives supporting peer-intervention programs across Nouvelle-Aquitaine. This part-time remote role involves guiding the design, development, and maintenance of digital tools and platforms, ensuring they are reliable, secure, and aligned with organizational goals. The Engineering Manager will oversee project planning, set priorities, and coordinate workflows across multidisciplinary teams, including engineers, product stakeholders, and program leads. Day-to-day responsibilities include conducting code and architecture reviews, mentoring team members, facilitating agile ceremonies, and resolving technical issues that affect delivery. The role also involves collaborating on requirements, defining engineering best practices, monitoring performance and quality metrics, and communicating progress, risks, and resource needs to leadership.
Qualifications

Demonstrated experience managing engineering teams, including planning, prioritization, and performance feedback.
Strong background in software development or systems engineering, with hands-on experience in modern technologies and frameworks.
Ability to define and implement engineering best practices for code quality, testing, security, and documentation.
Experience with remote collaboration tools and workflows, and the ability to lead distributed teams effectively.
Proficiency in project management methods (e.g., Agile, Scrum, Kanban) and tools for tracking tasks and milestones.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with a focus on reliability, scalability, and user-centered design.
Ability to work autonomously in a part-time capacity, manage multiple priorities, and meet agreed deadlines.
Experience working with non-profit, health, or social service organizations is an asset.
Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
